definitions.gloss: dual income; both spouses working; two-income household
definitions.explanation: A household where both husband and wife work and earn income. A common arrangement in modern Japan, increasingly discussed in the context of work-life balance and childcare.

examples.japanese: うちは{共稼|ともかせ}ぎだ。
{共稼|ともかせ}ぎの{夫婦|ふうふ}が{増|ふ}えている。
examples.english: The number of dual-income couples is increasing.

examples.japanese: {共稼|ともかせ}ぎでないと{住宅|じゅうたく}ローンの{返済|へんさい}が{厳|きび}しいと{感|かん}じる{家庭|かてい}も{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Many families feel that mortgage payments are tough without both spouses working.

notes:
USAGE:
Also written as {共働|ともばたら}き, which is the more common form in modern Japanese. {共稼|ともかせ}ぎ is slightly older but still used. Both refer to the same concept.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {共稼|ともかせ}ぎの{夫婦|ふうふ} (a dual-income couple)
- {共稼|ともかせ}ぎ{世帯|せたい} (a dual-income household)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {共働|ともばたら}き: dual income; both working — more common synonym, nearly interchangeable
- {片稼|かたかせ}ぎ: single-income — only one spouse working (less common term)
